profiles.name: Aeromancer

evidence.section: Air Mastery / Wind’s Embrace / Rebuking Gale
evidence.reason: Air Mastery / Wind’s Embrace / Rebuking Gale defines the material change from the Arcanist baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: While the practice of aeromancy is rare, some arcanists today are able to rival the aerial mastery of the ancient Shory aeromancers.
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters 1st, 5th, 11th-level Arcane Exploit; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
